title: 第811章 立天庭封天帝第810 充能拒绝
content_zh:
“多谢了......”
楚元看向身形愈发虚幻的溟，点头致意；
“还有一物......”
“什么？”
溟抬指点向虚空，无数道黑色和血色的纹路在虚空中浮现；
“此阵图与之相配，可令其杀伐倍增......”
阵图？在哪儿？
楚元悚然一惊，他感知到，这片存身的诡域在急剧缩小！
一个不可思议的猜想出现在他脑海中：“你把第四时代给炼了？”
“若我等转生，此界.....留之无用；
与其浪费，还不如为你增添一分胜算......”
楚元也不知道说什么好，站在他的角度来看，这自然是一件好事；
可若第四时代有灵，定然会大骂溟是个逆子......
不对，溟身上本来就有一半大宇宙意志；
他把他自己的残躯炼了？
楚元目光怪异：“.......你若转生，不会想把大宇宙也炼制成宝物吧？”
溟脸上竟然露出一抹缅怀之色：“这个想法，在第四时代尚存之时，就曾有人提出来过。
我也曾拿生灵至尊尝试过；
其肉身、灵魂、与体内世界共同炼制......
最终所得宝物，威力不逊色于本源至宝！

可是若想炼化大宇宙......按照如今的说法，除非合道成功，否则是不可能的。”
“.......”
这么邪门的么？
溟的脸色恢复淡然：“不过，我恐怕无法进入轮回了.......
你好生安置他们就行，不要忘了你的承诺。”
楚元眉头一皱，因果秩序探查而去；
便发现溟在消散......不只是他，所有第四时代诡异体内的大宇宙印记，似都有崩灭的预兆；
而溟在为他们‘输血’......
将自身所剩不多的大宇宙意志，分化亿万万，融入那些诡异至尊、主宰体内，帮助他们维持体内印记的完整。
“我有一事，一直想不通，不知道现在你能不能告诉我？”溟也不在意楚元探查，直言道：
“为何我一直感觉，吞了你，会有不可思议的好处？
这种吸引，甚至超过了对吞噬大宇宙的渴望........”
“不能。”楚元无情拒绝；
content_en:
"Thank you..."
Chu Yuan looked at Ming, whose figure was becoming more and more unreal, and nodded in greeting;
"There is one more thing..."
"What?"
Ming raised his finger to the void, and countless black and blood lines appeared in the void;
"If this formation is matched with it, its killing power can be doubled..."
Array diagram? Where?
Chu Yuan was horrified. He sensed that the mysterious realm where he lived was shrinking rapidly!
An incredible guess appeared in his mind: "Have you practiced the Fourth Age?"
“If we were reincarnated, this world would be left useless;
Instead of wasting it, it would be better to increase your chances of winning..."
Chu Yuan didn't know what to say. From his point of view, this was naturally a good thing;
But if there is a spirit in the fourth era, they will definitely curse Ming as a traitor...
No, Ming originally had half of the will of the universe;
Did he refine his own body?
Chu Yuan's eyes were strange: "...If you were reincarnated, wouldn't you want to refine the universe into a treasure?"
There was a trace of nostalgia on Ming's face: "This idea was proposed by someone when the Fourth Age still existed.
I also tried it with the Creature Supreme;
Its body, soul, and inner world are refined together...
The treasure obtained in the end is no less powerful than the original treasure!
But if you want to refine the universe...According to today's theory, it is impossible unless Hedao is successful. "
"...."
Is it so evil?
Ming's expression returned to calmness: "However, I'm afraid I won't be able to enter reincarnation...
Just settle them as you please, and don't forget your promise. "
Chu Yuan frowned and left to investigate the order of cause and effect;
Then he found that Ming was dissipating... Not just him, but all the imprints of the universe in the strange bodies of the fourth era seemed to have signs of collapse;
And Ming is 'transfusing blood' for them...
Divide the little remaining will of the universe into billions and integrate it into the bodies of those weird supremes and masters to help them maintain the integrity of the marks in their bodies.
"There's something I've been unable to figure out. I wonder if you can tell me now?" Ming didn't care about Chu Yuan's probing, and said bluntly:
"Why do I always feel that swallowing you will have incredible benefits?
This attraction even exceeds the desire to devour the universe..."
"No." Chu Yuan refused ruthlessly;
